title: Bug 635072: Subcontracting order uses Prod. Order Line location, not Work Center
summary: The subcontracting order creation process now consistently uses the production order line location instead of the work center location when creating purchase orders, aligning with the worksheet calculation path.
key_points: The InsertReqWkshLine function previously overrode requisition line locations with work center locations
Both Create Subcontracting Order and CalculateSubcontracts paths now use production order line location consistently
Test coverage added to verify location handling in subcontracting workflows
quote: Standardize on the Prod. Order Line location to match the two existing correct implementations.
